label: Scaleway infrastructure connector
summary: Prepare account/project-aware discovery and approved cloud lifecycle integration for a selected Scaleway profile.
core_boundary: The connector contributes provider mappings and observations; it cannot replace Core authority or choose arbitrary host operations. This is a design-only connector proposal. Essential hosting, current actor and tenant authorization, native service drivers and recovery remain in the free Core. No production interface, publisher trust, installation or effectful capability is established by this metadata.
acceptance: Qualify organization, project and regional references for the chosen service and API revision.
Test allowlisted image/network/volume specifications and reject unsupported capabilities explicitly.
Verify quota exhaustion, cancelled provisioning and recovery without exposing provider credentials.

Before implementation, qualify an explicitly selected provider/interface revision, supported compatibility matrix, immutable package provenance, dependency inventory and licensing model; no release is admitted by this proposal.

Enforce current Core actor, tenant and capability checks at each admitted request; keep credentials in scoped secret references, redact diagnostics and reject arbitrary destinations, shell commands or host/container sockets.

Demonstrate that disablement, removal, provider outage and commercial entitlement loss preserve essential Core access, hosted workloads, local audit and recovery; retain owned data unless a separately authorized purge is requested.
